an7.41:1.1: “Bhikkhus, having seven qualities Sāriputta has mastered his mind and is not mastered by it.
an7.41:1.3: Sāriputta is skilled at concentration, skilled in entering concentration, skilled in remaining in concentration, skilled in emerging from concentration, skilled in positivity for concentration, skilled in the territory of concentration, and skilled in projecting the mind purified by concentration.
an7.41:1.4: Having these seven qualities Sāriputta has mastered his mind and is not mastered by it.”
